### Related Context in the Retrieved Set

The corpus returned four other WordPress access-control CVEs. They are **not** the same vulnerability and do not affect Pre-Publish Post Checklist, but they are useful as a class-level view of this weakness pattern in the WordPress plugin ecosystem:

- **CVE-2025-11734** — Broken Link Checker by AIOSEO (vendor: aioseo), versions ≤ 1.2.5. MEDIUM, CVSS 5.4, CWE-862. REST endpoint checks only a broad capability (`aioseo_blc_broken_links_page`) granted to contributors, without per-post permission verification; contributor+ can trash arbitrary posts via `DELETE /wp-json/aioseoBrokenLinkChecker/v1/post`.
- **CVE-2024-2505** — GamiPress (vendor: gamipress), before 6.8.9. HIGH, CVSS 8.1 (no CWE assigned in the record). Authors can manipulate requests to extend settings access to lower-privileged users such as Subscribers.

- **CVE-2023-1026** — WP Meta SEO (vendor: joomunited), versions ≤ 4.5.3. MEDIUM, CVSS 4.3, CWE-862. Missing capability check on `listPostsCategory`; the plugin relied on a nonce reachable by all authenticated users as its access control, letting subscribers enumerate published posts by category.
